text: AESUM, in _Ancint Geography, a town of Adenia_ _Payria_, five miles from the place where Hellic flood, and famous for the council of the Askens, which ofu- ally met there on account either of the depth or com- moding fluctuation of the place. It was also famous for the worthy of _Oasyaya, Zoni, Connecticut Jupiter_, and _of Panachema Grers._ The territory of _Egitan was_ welenced by my rivers, via the Phoenix and Meganies. The eptiples is _Egimfu_. There is a coin in the cabinet of the king of Praffia, with the infarction ARTI, and the figure of a tusntic, which is the symbol of Pele Jopomeneña, and leaves no doubt as to the place where it was struck.
